lines.en: Half of me is orange, half is green.
Through damp ground the green deepens.
My feet are patched with verdigris.
I head toward that rock layer.
Copper rust drops along the way.
Step by step. Slowly.
My route winds about.
My skin is changing color.
I drag a faint metallic sound.
Around this pile, then on.

lines.zh: 我不知道会炸成什么样。
lines.en: I don't know what I'll burst into.
I'm looking for stone with copper.
Rain makes my color change.
I walk light and slow.
I stop and sniff the ground.
There's a green patch on my tail.
I stand and the rust creeps down.

lines.zh: 身上这块绿是我自己的。
lines.en: This green is my own doing.
There's an acid smell in the air.
I wait for the right ground.
Metal tightens inside me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天会不会下雨。
lines.en: I look up to see if it'll rain.
I lift a paw and scrape off rust.
It's drier than the last place.

lines.zh: 我的颜色一天比一天深。
lines.en: My color deepens day by day.
I'm listening to echoes in the rock.
The green parts are a bit soft.
I keep still and slowly swell.
There's a little warmth on me.
This ground is good for copper.
I have something to say. It won't come.
I shudder and shed rust dust.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西是铜的吗？
lines.en: Is what you hold copper?
The thing at your belt carries a current.
Don't stand in the damp.

lines.zh: 我这一身颜色，你还认得出吗？
lines.en: Recognize me in these colors?
You stepped on my rust.
You want copper? I have plenty.

lines.zh: 你的护甲是铁的，不导电吗？
lines.en: Iron armor. Does it conduct?
I don't hurt people. I change ground.
I look at you to measure time.
Step back. I'm beginning.

lines.zh: 你身上已经开始发绿了。
lines.en: You're starting to go green.

lines.zh: 你脚下这块石会变颜色。
lines.en: The stone under you will change.
A flake of rust came off.
My copper skin dents; I keep swelling.
The cracks widened.
You've got copper dust on your hands.

lines.zh: 我退了一点，地上有痕迹。
lines.en: I moved back, leaving a mark.
That made me swell more.
Metal is ringing inside me.
I'm colder now.
All you knocked loose was flakes.
Only my color changed.
That bit of copper is too small.
I don't eat. I draw from stone.
That'll rust if you leave it out.
Keep it away. Moisture bothers me.
Not hungry. Looking for an ore layer.
Don't handle that copper with sweaty hands.
Don't wave it. Copper glare is sharp.
It's worth something. I won't trade.

lines.zh: 你把它埋起来也许有用。
lines.en: Burying it might help.
I don't need it. I need time.
I don't know that color.
Stay back. I'm swelling.
Reaching for me? Don't.
Too much copper smell. I'm dizzy.
Keep it. I've nowhere to put it.
That gets heavier in the rain.
Bump me and you get a green smudge.
I'm heavier than I look.
You'll have rust on your hand after.
Don't crowd. I'll give you a little room.
That scraped some skin off me.
I'm cool and slightly slick.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是石头一样的东西。
lines.en: You hit something like stone.
You scuffed the rust on the ground.
I can barely stand steady.
The part you touched is green.

lines.zh: 这事在湿的地方会更快。
lines.en: This goes faster in the damp.
We've both gone rusty.
The colors go together rather well.

lines.zh: 别看了，这没什么好看的。
lines.en: Don't watch. There's nothing to see.
We press together and the rust mingles.
It's much greener than me.
The ground around here will change color.
We shed powder everywhere parting.
Not breeding. Blending.
Quiet. Metal carries sound.
I pick up a piece of copper ore.
This stone has a good color.
It tastes sour; I spit the copper out.

lines.zh: 手上的锈印在石头上了。
lines.en: Rust from my hand marked the stone.
Cold against my hand, like after rain.
I picked it up and it discolored.
I'll keep this for my spot.
There's copper filings on the ground.
I'm bad at picking up small things.
A corner came off that thing of yours.
The stone you're on has copper.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就在矿脉边上。
lines.en: I see you, by the vein.
I'm coming this way.
I'll turn this patch to copper.
The ground under you is changing.
Small range, but you're close.
There's copper dust on your soles.
This damp stone is just right.
Your iron will draw the current.
The cracks on me are going green.
The smell of rust leads me your way.
You went behind the stone.
I follow your traces.
The stone here is grey.
My steps are slow; my rust never stops falling.
The further back, the safer.
Rust keeps falling off me.
There's room for one burst here.
You went all the way round.
I creep along the damp wall.
I burst and the stone turns green.
Not striking you. Changing the stone.
Copper flakes flew all over you.
You were shoved two steps.
The whole ring turned to copper ore.
My hide split and the rust smell spread.
Your armor is green all over.
The grass is buried now.
There isn't much of me left.
The edge of this hole is neat.
I seep out of the rock seam.
There's copper down here.
I landed heavily.
A green streak appeared on the wall.
I smell metal.
The stone here carries color.
I stood up and shed rust.
I waited here a while.
You've been digging copper up there.
My cracks are glowing.
Fire made the copper shine brighter.
I broke into flakes on landing.
Water soaked through and the rust came off.

lines.zh: 两股气一起冲，石头全翻了。
lines.en: Both bursts went off and the stone flipped.
The arrow pulled out a spray of green.
That light changed the copper's color at once.
I don't eat food. I eat stone.
The bolt ran down the copper on me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有石头给我变。
lines.en: There's no stone to change in the void.
